# Packaging and distribution reference

This reference is extracted programmatically from `manifest.scm`,
`guix.scm`, `release/contract.env`, and `doc/releasing.md` so it
cannot drift from the real build recipe or release contract. For
narrative packaging guidance see
[`../releasing.md`](../releasing.md); for the roadmap decision
record see
[`../release-roadmap.md`](../release-roadmap.md#release-decisions).

Release-candidate version: `1.0.0-rc1` (from
`release/contract.env`).

## Installed file layout (from the `install` phase of `guix.scm`)

| Path (relative to the package output) | Contents |
|---|---|
| `bin` | minde binary, minde-session wrapper, REPL-socket helpers (minde-cmd, minde-msg, mindectl) |
| `share/minde` | runtime Scheme tree and default-config.scm |
| `share/guile/site/3.0` | installed minde Guile modules (GUILE_LOAD_PATH root) |
| `share/doc/minde` | README, changelog, policies, provenance, licenses, doc/, release/ |
| `share/wayland-sessions` | minde.desktop Wayland session entry |

## Wayland session entry

`share/wayland-sessions/minde.desktop` runs `Exec=minde-session`,
which is installed at `bin/minde-session`. The wrapper sets
`XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP`, `MINDE_SCHEME_DIR`, `GUILE_LOAD_PATH`, and
`__EGL_VENDOR_LIBRARY_DIRS`, falls back to the packaged
`init.scm` when `~/.config/minde/init.scm` is absent, and execs
`bin/minde --tty`, redirecting output to
`$XDG_STATE_HOME/minde/session.log` (previous-generation log kept
as `session.previous.log`).

## Obtaining and verifying release archives

Two deterministic archives are produced per tagged release (see
[`../releasing.md`](../releasing.md#reproducible-archives)):

- `minde-$VERSION.tar.gz` -- source only, excludes `vendor/`.
- `minde-$VERSION-vendored.tar.gz` -- source plus the vendored
  Cargo dependency graph, suitable for fully offline Cargo and Guix
  builds and required by `guix/release.scm`.

Both are built with `make release-archives VERSION=$VERSION` and
verified reproducible with `make check-release-archives`; archive
order, ownership, timestamps, tar format, and gzip metadata are
normalized so two independent builds are byte-identical. A published
release additionally provides a `SHA256SUMS` file (produced by
`make release`) alongside the archives; verify a downloaded archive
with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` before extracting it.

## Installing via the in-repo Guix channel

This repository is a Guix channel (`.guix-channel` ->
`guix-channel/`, see
[`../../guix-channel/minde/packages.scm`](../../guix-channel/minde/packages.scm)).
Add it to `~/.config/guix/channels.scm` and run `guix pull`, or
build directly against a checkout without pulling:

```sh
guix build -L guix-channel guile-minde-foundation
guix build -L guix-channel guile-minde-ui
```

**What the channel provides today:** only the two reusable, pure-Scheme
libraries, `guile-minde-foundation` and `guile-minde-ui`.
**What it does not yet provide:** the `minde` compositor itself. The
compositor's Guix recipe (`guix.scm`) builds from a vendored Cargo
dependency tree under `vendor/`, which is deliberately gitignored and
therefore invisible to a channel checkout (`guix pull` only sees
committed files). The channel will gain a `minde` package once a
tagged release publishes the vendored archive
(`minde-$VERSION-vendored.tar.gz`) at a stable URL with a known
hash, at which point the channel package can `url-fetch` it exactly
as `guix/release.scm` does from `MINDE_SOURCE_ARCHIVE`. Until
then, installing the compositor requires a checkout and `guix.scm`
(or `guix/release.scm` against a locally vendored archive), as
described above.

## Screen capture and desktop-portal support

Extracted from `doc/capability-matrix.md` (the capability-status
source of truth):

```
| Screencopy/screenshot protocol | experimental | `ext-image-copy-capture-v1` + `ext-image-capture-source-v1` (output sources) and legacy `wlr-screencopy-unstable-v1` v3 (wf-recorder, `xdg-desktop-portal-wlr`); both share one capture queue. grim (ext) and wf-recorder (wlr) shm capture verified nested (winit), full-frame damage, honest region capture; udev/DRM path and portal browser sharing want hardware verification |
```

`grim` is part of the development shell (`manifest.scm`) and is
the reference client: Guix packages `grim` 1.5.0, which speaks
`ext-image-copy-capture-v1` and works against minde today.

**Portal-based screen sharing is now expected to work, pending
owner hardware verification.** minde serves the legacy
`wlr-screencopy-unstable-v1` (v3) protocol alongside
`ext-image-copy-capture-v1`, so the screen-cast portal backend
packaged in Guix, `xdg-desktop-portal-wlr` (0.8.2) -- which speaks
`wlr-screencopy` only -- can now capture minde's outputs, which
is the path browser screen sharing uses. `wf-recorder`, another
pure `wlr-screencopy` client, is exercised by the nested e2e gate.
The portal path itself has been wired but not yet verified on real
hardware/PipeWire; a portal backend speaking
`ext-image-copy-capture-v1` directly (such as
`xdg-desktop-portal-luminous`) remains an alternative but is not
currently packaged in Guix. See
[`../release-roadmap.md`](../release-roadmap.md#sprint-13--screen-capture-and-desktop-portal)
for the tracked follow-up.

## Support boundary

First-party support target: pinned Guix, installed either from a
checkout (`guix.scm`) or, for the two reusable libraries, from this
repository's Guix channel. Other distributions are community-packaged
from the vendored release archive
(`minde-$VERSION-vendored.tar.gz`), offline and reproducible by
construction, but their packaging and testing are not first-party (see
[`../release-roadmap.md`](../release-roadmap.md#release-decisions) and
[`../support.md`](../support.md)).
